text: They soon crossed the outposts. <break time="0.8s" /> Passed through the empty town of Colombes. <break time="0.8s" /> And found themselves. <break time="0.8s" /> Among small vineyards. <break time="0.8s" /> That sloped down to the Seine. <break time="0.8s" /> It was about eleven oclock. <break time="0.8s" /> And on the other side of the river. <break time="0.8s" /> The village of Argenteuil seemed dead. <break time="0.8s" /> Above it rose. <break time="0.8s" /> The heights of Orgemont and Sannois. <break time="0.8s" /> And the great plain toward Nanterre. <break time="0.8s" /> Lay empty. <break time="0.8s" /> With only its bare cherry trees. <break time="0.8s" /> Pointing at the hilltops. <break time="0.8s" /> Sauvage said. <break time="0.8s" /> The Prussians are up there. <break time="0.8s" /> And a strange fear. <break time="0.8s" /> Froze the two friends. <break time="0.8s" /> They had never seen a Prussian. <break time="0.8s" /> Yet for months. <break time="0.8s" /> They had felt them all around Paris. <break time="0.8s" /> Unseen but all powerful. <break time="0.8s" /> Ruining France. <break time="0.8s" /> And starving the city. <break time="0.8s" /> What if we met some of them. <break time="0.8s" /> Morissot asked. <break time="0.8s" /> And Sauvage answered. <break time="0.8s" /> With a Parisian joke. <break time="0.8s" /> We would offer them some fried fish. <break time="0.8s" /> Still they hesitated. <break time="0.8s" /> But at last they crept down. <break time="0.8s" /> Through the vines. <break time="0.8s" /> Bent low. <break time="0.8s" /> Their eyes anxious. <break time="0.8s" /> And their ears listening. <break time="0.8s" /> After running across. <break time="0.8s" /> A strip of bare ground. <break time="0.8s" /> They hid among the dry reeds. <break time="0.8s" /> And Morissot put his ear to the ground. <break time="0.8s" /> Hearing nothing. <break time="0.8s" /> Sure that they were alone. <break time="0.8s" /> They began to fish. <break time="0.8s" /> And soon the little silver gudgeons. <break time="0.8s" /> Were biting one after another. <break time="0.8s" /> Filling them with delight.
